# Accordion

Expand or reduce a content section.
See [Accordion guidelines<i class="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/accordion/design/)

Please see <LinkTo kind="Components/Collapsible" story="docs">Collapsible</LinkTo> for further informations on its props

<Source code="import { Accordion, Collapsible } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

- Any other props supplied will be provided to the root element
- For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/Accordion/index.ts)

## Examples

### Dark mode

<Canvas of={AccordionStories.Dark} />

Details about implementing dark mode is available in <LinkTo kind="General/Visual Styles/Introduction" story="docs">Visual Styles Page</LinkTo>

### Default

use `defaultIndex` to define initial index(es) of the expanded accordion item(s)

<Canvas of={AccordionStories.Default} />

### Single

Use this option to allow only one item to be expanded.

<Canvas of={AccordionStories.Single} />

### Max height

To constraint the maximum height of the Accordion

- use a parent with a fixed height
- set `autoFit` prop on the items you want to take maximum space

<Canvas of={AccordionStories.MaxHeight} />

```css
.w-480 {
  width: 480px;
}
.h-360 {
  height: 360px;
}
```

### Custom unfold/collapse labels

To set custom labels for the "Collapse all" and "Unfold all" buttons use `unfoldAllLabel` and/or `collapseAllLabel` props.

<Canvas of={AccordionStories.CustomLabels} />
